Fetch boxers from BoxingBook API

Source: R/fetch_boxingbook_boxers.R
fetch_boxingbook_boxers.Rd

Retrieves a list of boxers from the BoxingBook API with support for pagination, sorting, and comprehensive filtering options. This function provides access to detailed boxer profiles including personal information, fight records, and career statistics.

Usage

fetch_boxingbook_boxers(
  page = 0,
  page_size = 50,
  sort = NULL,
  first_name = NULL,
  last_name = NULL,
  nick_name = NULL,
  quick_search = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  birth_country = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  gender = NULL,
  age = NULL,
  age_query_type = NULL,
  fights = NULL,
  fights_query_type = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  weight_query_type = NULL,
  include_exhibitions = NULL,
  boxer_id = NULL,
  timeout = 30
)

Arguments

page

Integer. Page number for pagination (default: 0).

page_size

Integer. Number of records per page, max 100 (default: 50).

sort

Character. Sorting criteria in format "field1,field2,ORDER" where ORDER is ASC or DESC (default: NULL for API default).

first_name

Character. Filter by boxer's first name (optional).

last_name

Character. Filter by boxer's last name (optional).

nick_name

Character. Filter by boxer's nickname (optional).

quick_search

Character. General search across name fields (optional).

country

Character. Filter by boxer's current country (optional).

birth_country

Character. Filter by boxer's birth country (optional).

state

Character. Filter by boxer's state/province (optional).

gender

Character. Filter by gender: "male" or "female" (optional).

age

Integer. Filter by specific age (optional).

age_query_type

Character. Age comparison type: "EQUAL", "GREATER_THAN", "LESS_THAN", "GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL", "LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL" (optional).

fights

Integer. Filter by number of fights (optional).

fights_query_type

Character. Fights comparison type: same options as age_query_type (optional).

weight

Numeric. Filter by weight in kg (optional).

weight_query_type

Character. Weight comparison type: same options as age_query_type (optional).

include_exhibitions

Logical. Whether to include exhibition matches in counts (optional).

boxer_id

Integer. Filter by specific boxer ID - will return single boxer (optional).

timeout

Numeric. Request timeout in seconds (default: 30).

Value

A data.frame containing boxer information with columns for personal details, fight records, physical attributes, and career statistics. Returns an empty data.frame if no boxers are found.

Details

The function connects to the BoxingBook API to retrieve boxer data with comprehensive filtering capabilities. It includes error handling for network issues, API errors, and malformed responses.

The API contains over 25,000 boxer records with detailed information including:

  • Personal information (name, age, nationality, stance)

  • Fight statistics (wins, losses, draws, exhibitions)

  • Physical attributes (weight, calculated weight)

  • Career details (gym, verification status, activity)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get first 50 boxers (default)
boxers <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers()

# Search by name
ali_boxers <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(last_name = "Ali")

# Filter by country and gender
aus_female <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(
  country = "Australia",
  gender = "female"
)

# Active boxers with more than 10 fights
experienced <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(
  fights = 10,
  fights_query_type = "GREATER_THAN"
)

# Quick search across all name fields
search_results <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(quick_search = "Mike")

# Get specific boxer by ID (alternative to fetch_boxingbook_boxer)
specific_boxer <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(boxer_id = 30794)

# Heavyweights (over 90kg)
heavyweights <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(
  weight = 90,
  weight_query_type = "GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL"
)
} # }
